question: Should OpenClaw land this source-layer `provider.model` backfill before the broader memory provider auto-detection work is resolved?
rationale: The patch is narrow and appears correct, but it changes the canonical model identity consumed by persisted memory metadata and vector lookup when an adapter returns an empty model, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Land after upgrade-aware review
options.body: Accept the focused backfill if maintainers are satisfied that normalizing empty provider models is the intended upgrade behavior for existing memory indexes.

options.body: Ask for a live existing-index reindex plus `memory_search` query transcript before merge if stronger end-to-end storage proof is required.
